sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Monotypic; type species Caribitermes discolor (Banks, 1919), previously placed in Parvitermes. Head capsule very slightly constricted behind the antennae; the genus was described on this character, the imago mandibles and the gut anatomy.
